_comment: Disasters, Paradox style. While the trigger holds, progress rises each month (progress_per_month); otherwise it falls (decline_per_month). At 100 the disaster strikes: on_start effects, then its modifiers hold until the end condition has held for min_years years, when on_end effects apply. Conditions and effects are those of events.

disasters.name: Civil war
disasters.description: The great families take up arms against a throne they no longer respect.

on_start.message: Civil war: the provinces rise against the crown.

on_end.message: The civil war is over: the crown stands.

disasters.name: Peasants' revolt
disasters.description: Worn down by war and want, the villages refuse their dues.

on_start.message: The peasants revolt: tax collectors are driven from the villages.

on_end.message: The villages return to their dues.

disasters.name: Revolt of the nobles
disasters.description: The lords of the provinces, slighted too long, defy the crown.

on_start.message: The nobles revolt: the levies stay home and the provinces answer to their lords.

on_end.message: The nobles are reconciled to the crown.

disasters.name: Quarrel with the temples
disasters.description: The priests close the temples against a king who starves the gods.

on_start.message: The temples turn against the crown: the gods, the priests say, have withdrawn their favour.

on_end.message: The temples open their doors to the king again.

disasters.name: Crisis of succession
disasters.description: An old king, a doubtful heir, and every faction choosing its candidate.

on_start.message: The succession is in doubt: the court divides into factions.
